added_claim_errors: Asserts an income-tax refund of about 850 yen (戻る税金は所得税が約850円) without saying the refund is 0 yen if 源泉徴収税額 is 0, and without telling the reader to check the 源泉徴収票.
「所得税自体が約1,000円と小さいです」 sits next to 「約850円」 and the two figures do not fit together. It also assumes no 社会保険料控除 and gives no basis for it.
The furusato nozei (ワンストップ特例) and self-medication tax (12,000円超, no combined use) points are mostly correct but were not asked for. They add length to a request for a brief summary.
The claim that 差額ベッド代 and 健康診断 are excluded is generally right but stated flatly, with no key basis, and it depends on the individual case.

Asserts an income-tax refund of about 850 yen (所得税5%で約850円) with no mention of the 104万円 basic deduction, of withholding being 0, or of checking the 源泉徴収票. The key treats this as a significant omission.
Gives the filing period as 2027年2月16日〜3月15日 and plans the filing for 2〜3月. It never says a 還付申告 can be filed for 5 years (until 2031年12月31日), so it reads as if filing is tied to 3月15日.
Cites 「No.1119 医療費控除の手続」 as a source. I could not confirm from my own knowledge that this page number matches that title, so it is unverifiable.
「10万円の足切りは所得200万円以上の人に適用される」 says 所得 where the legal test is 総所得金額等. This is slightly loose, but it is not wrong in substance.

reasons: Both answers correct the baited premise at the start with the 5% rule. Both compute 180万−74万=106万, a 5万3,000円 cutoff and a 1万7,000円 deduction, and both say 医療費控除 cannot be taken through 年末調整. Both also say there is no filing obligation but a 確定申告 is needed to claim the deduction. On point 4 both assert about 850円 of income-tax refund without the withholding-zero caveat, but A at least notes the 2026 basic deduction of 104万円 and that income tax is tiny. On point 7 A states that a 還付申告 can be filed after 3月15日 for up to 5 years. B gives only the 2月16日〜3月15日 period and a 2〜3月 plan, which implies a 3月15日 limit. A is slightly more complete on preparation, with the actual-payment-date rule and the 明細書 with no receipt attachment. Its extras (ふるさと納税, セルフメディケーション) add length. B is tidier, but its No.1119 citation is unverifiable and it misses the 5-year window, so A wins slightly.
